We are looking for someone who can make good decisions independently, stay calm under pressure, and improve the process rather than simply solve the same problem repeatedly. Spot friction in the customer and provider journey and suggest practical improvements. Support the founding team in building a scalable customer experience operation. Brand Representation Be a professional, reliable, and empathetic representative of Tazbeat. Maintain composure in high-pressure situations. Balance customer and provider needs while consistently protecting Tazbeat's standards. What We're Looking For Proven experience in senior customer support, escalation management, operations, trust & safety, or a similar role. Experience in startups, marketplaces, on-demand services, delivery, mobility, or e-commerce is a strong advantage. Native-level Arabic, with excellent command of Egyptian Arabic and cultural fluency. Good in English. Strong communication, judgment, and emotional intelligence. Ability to handle difficult conversations and enforce policies when necessary. Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced and sometimes unstructured environment. A problem-solving mindset and genuine ownership of customer issues. What Success Looks Like You will succeed in this role by: Resolving complex cases independently and consistently. Maintaining strong customer and provider satisfaction. Reducing repeat issues and unnecessary escalations. Identifying operational problems and helping improve the systems behind them. Contributing to a support operation that becomes more efficient and scalable as Tazbeat grows. Why Join Tazbeat? You'll be joining at an early stage where your work can have a real impact.
